title: sempervivum marmoreum subsp. erythraeum
intro: Sempervivum marmoreum subsp. erythraeum, commonly known as Houseleek or Mountain Aloe, is a species of succulent plant within the family Crassulaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits such as wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Sempervivum marmoreum subsp. erythraeum include its use in treating skin conditions, digestive issues, and respiratory problems, while also exhibiting antioxidant and anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects and potential health benefits.
